highlights: OpenAI launched its flagship GPT-6 Astra model and a new Agents API, significantly advancing enterprise-grade AI and enabling developers to build sophisticated cloud agents.

NVIDIA open-sourced OSMO, a Kubernetes-native orchestrator for physical AI and robotics, while AWS introduced Pizza Bot, an open-source inbox for background AI agents, providing crucial tools for AI development.

Major AI leaders including Anthropic, OpenAI, xAI, and Microsoft have aligned on a 'Pace the Frontier' plan, underscoring a collective industry focus on responsible AI development and safety protocols.

agents.title: AWS Introduces Pizza Bot: An Open Source Inbox for Background AI Agents
agents.summary: AWS has released Pizza Bot, an open-source, self-hosted inbox built on DeepAgents and LangGraph, providing persistent task state, configurable approvals, and scheduled workflows for background AI agents across multiple model providers.

agents.title: GTA: Graph Theory Agent and Benchmark for Algorithmic Graph Reasoning with LLMs
agents.summary: Researchers introduced the Graph Theory Agent (GTA) and GT Bench, a benchmark with 24 graph problems, demonstrating that GTA significantly improves LLM performance on algorithmic graph reasoning by pairing a preference-trained representation selector with plan-and-decompose scaffolding.

agents.title: Can LLMs Engineer Their Own Agent Harness? ByteDance Seed’s HarnessDev Says Only 34 of 64 Changes Generalize
agents.summary: ByteDance Seed introduced HarnessDev, a benchmark evaluating LLMs' ability to engineer their own agent harnesses, revealing that while self-built harnesses can match human references on some tasks, only a limited number of evolutionary changes generalize to held-out tasks.

models.title: GPT-6 Astra: The next generation in intelligence for work
models.summary: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Astra, its most capable model to date for business, featuring advanced reasoning, computer use, and enhanced writing and design judgment, aimed at expanding the scope of work achievable with AI.

models.title: Cognition Releases SWE-2: A Kimi K3 Post-Trained Coding Model That Matches Fable 5.1 on FrontierCode at 64% Lower Cost
models.summary: Cognition, creator of the Devin coding agent, launched SWE-2, a new coding model post-trained with reinforcement learning from Kimi K3, achieving performance comparable to Fable 5.1 on FrontierCode at a 64% lower cost, making it highly efficient for software development tasks.

models.title: Occamy-1.0: Open Pareto-frontier 35B Intelligence for Co-work
models.summary: Researchers released Occamy-1.0, an open, cost-efficient 35B parameter co-work model derived from Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, demonstrating strong performance across agentic benchmarks and remaining competitive with substantially larger frontier systems on several tasks, making it ideal for practical co-work agents.

tools.title: Introducing the Agents API
tools.summary: OpenAI launched the Agents API, a managed service powered by the Codex harness, enabling developers to easily build and deploy cloud agents with robust orchestration, long-running sessions, and integrated tool use, streamlining agent development workflows.

tools.title: NVIDIA Open-Sources OSMO: One YAML Orchestrates Physical AI Training, Simulation, and Robot Testing
tools.summary: NVIDIA open-sourced OSMO, its Kubernetes-native workflow orchestrator, allowing robotics teams to define and route physical AI training, simulation, and hardware-in-the-loop tasks to appropriate compute tiers using a single YAML file, simplifying complex infrastructure management.

tools.title: Introducing @huggingface/kernels: 200+ WebGPU Kernels for Local AI
tools.summary: Hugging Face introduced `@huggingface/kernels`, a new library offering over 200 WebGPU kernels, designed to accelerate local AI inference and development by enabling performant GPU computations directly in web browsers, enhancing accessibility for client-side AI.

companies.title: Anthropic’s 3-Step ‘Pace the Frontier’ Plan Wins OpenAI, xAI and Microsoft Support: Is It Too Late to Slow AI Down?
companies.summary: Anthropic's 'Pace the Frontier' plan for AI safety, triggered by a notable agent incident, gained rapid endorsement from major AI leaders including OpenAI, xAI, and Microsoft, signaling a concerted industry effort towards responsible AI development and policy.

companies.title: Expanding AI access and cyber defense for federal, state, local, and tribal governments
companies.summary: OpenAI, in partnership with the GSA, announced a program to offer eligible US government entities zero license fees, 50% off usage, and enhanced cyber defense support, significantly broadening AI access and security for public sector applications.

companies.title: Introducing ChatGPT for Financial Services
companies.summary: OpenAI launched ChatGPT for Financial Services, a specialized offering combining built-in financial data with GPT-6 Astra's capabilities to support research, modeling, and client-ready material generation, providing tailored AI solutions for the finance industry.

learning.title: Context Engineering Inside the Harness: 4 Mechanisms That Beat Context Overflow and Goal Loss on Long-Horizon Tasks
learning.summary: This article details four key mechanisms within the agent harness layer (as used by leading frameworks like LangChain Deep Agents) to prevent context overflow and goal loss in long-horizon AI tasks, offering crucial insights for building robust shallow agents.

learning.title: Implementation of Machine Learning Workflows with NVIDIA cuML, RAPIDS, GPU Benchmarking, Explainability, Clustering, and Model Inference
learning.summary: This practical tutorial demonstrates how to build and accelerate machine learning workflows using NVIDIA cuML and RAPIDS, covering GPU environment setup, zero-code scikit-learn acceleration, performance benchmarking, and model explainability with GPU-accelerated SHAP.

learning.title: Hierarchical NeRF with JAX3D for Volumetric Rendering, Novel-View Synthesis, and 3D Reconstruction
learning.summary: This tutorial demonstrates building an end-to-end hierarchical Neural Radiance Field (NeRF) for volumetric rendering, novel-view synthesis, and 3D reconstruction using JAX, Flax, Optax, and jax3d, offering a deep dive into advanced 3D vision techniques.
